search_text: published ZDI-07-067 ZDI-CAN-241 Apple QuickTime PICT File Poly Opcodes Heap Corruption Vulnerability 2007-11-05 CVE-2007-4676 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2007-4676 ['Apple'] ['Quicktime'] This vulnerability allows attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Apple QuickTime. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exist in the parsing of Poly type opcodes (opcodes 0x0070-74). Due to improper handling of a malformed element in the structure heap corruption occurs. If properly constructed this can lead to code execution. Apple has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: http://docs.info.apple.com/article.html?artnum=306896 ['2007-09-14 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2007-11-05 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Ruben Santamarta of reversemode.com https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-07-067/
